screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a draftsperson?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
candidates.summary: Drafting role on industrial, commercial and residential building projects in Melbourne's Northern Suburbs.
candidates.opening:
- Employment opportunity exists for our very busy, successful and rapidly growing company.
- Full time work.
- Flexible Hours.
- Office located in Melbourne’s Northern Suburbs.
- Close to public transport and shops.
- Free car parking close to office.
- Possibly work from home.
- Work on Industrial, Commercial and Residential building projects.
- Immediate start.
The successful applicant will have the following skills and attributes:
- Some 2D AutoCAD experience and/or 3D Tekla experience.
- Some experience in concrete panel detailing is preferred but not required.
- An educational and/or work background in the building industry.
- The ability to visualise in 3D from 2D drawings.
- Strong attention to detail and possess a high degree of accuracy.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
key_lines: - Close to public transport and shops.
- Free car parking close to office.
- Work on Industrial, Commercial and Residential building projects.
- Some 2D AutoCAD experience and/or 3D Tekla experience.
- Some experience in concrete panel detailing is preferred but not required.
- Strong attention to detail and possess a high degree of accuracy.
Willing to train those with no concrete panel detailing experience. Ideal for drafting and engineering students or new graduates.
Salary and hours are negotiable for the right candidate and is based on experience.
Email your cover letter and resume' by selecting the above pink "Quick apply" button.
